$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema this LocalConnectionsConfig file follows (the $schema annotation), for editors and validators. Pinned to the vN tag of the format version it describes.
$schema.title: $schema

EnableGrpc.description: Whether to enable the gRPC server
EnableGrpc.title: EnableGrpc

GrpcListenAddress.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) the gRPC server binds to. Requires GrpcListenPort. Defaults to 127.0.0.1
GrpcListenAddress.title: GrpcListenAddress

GrpcListenPort.description: TCP port the gRPC server listens on. When set, the gRPC server listens over HTTP/2 rather than on a unix socket, without TLS unless GrpcTlsCertificateFile is also given. Mutually exclusive with GrpcSocketPath
GrpcListenPort.title: GrpcListenPort

GrpcSocketPath.description: Path of the gRPC server socket. Mutually exclusive with GrpcListenPort
GrpcSocketPath.title: GrpcSocketPath

GrpcTlsCertificateFile.description: Path of the gRPC server's TLS certificate (PEM). Enables TLS; requires GrpcTlsPrivateKeyFile and GrpcListenPort
GrpcTlsCertificateFile.title: GrpcTlsCertificateFile

GrpcTlsChainCertificateFiles.description: Paths of the intermediate certificates to include in the gRPC server's TLS chain (PEM)
GrpcTlsChainCertificateFiles.title: GrpcTlsChainCertificateFiles

GrpcTlsPrivateKeyFile.description: Path of the private key matching GrpcTlsCertificateFile (PEM)
GrpcTlsPrivateKeyFile.title: GrpcTlsPrivateKeyFile

SocketPath.description: Path of the socket for local clients
SocketPath.title: SocketPath
